subject.title: fix: keep crabbox runtime state out of sync

question: Should Crabbox reserve `.crabbox/env`, `.crabbox/scripts`, `.crabbox/logs`, `.crabbox/captures`, and `.crabbox/runs` as final sync excludes even for repositories that previously tracked files there?
rationale: The patch is narrow and security-positive, but it intentionally changes upgrade behavior for users who stored project files in the newly reserved runtime directories.

options.title: Accept reserved runtime paths
options.body: Merge with the documented contract that these five subdirectories are Crabbox-owned runtime state and project files must live elsewhere.

options.title: Add a compatibility path first
options.body: Require an explicit migration, fallback, or opt-in strict mode before existing tracked files under those directories stop syncing.

options.title: Narrow the protected set
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want only some runtime directories protected while leaving others user-syncable.

recommendation.title: Accept reserved runtime paths
recommendation.body: Merge with the documented contract that these five subdirectories are Crabbox-owned runtime state and project files must live elsewhere.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest history match for the sync/runtime boundary and also authored the latest hardening commits on the PR branch.
